agent.response:
Use views instead of CTEs or subqueries for this specific task.

```sql
SELECT region,
       AVG(revenue) AS avg_sale_revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY region
HAVING AVG(revenue) > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM sales);
```
